notes: Source of truth for level design. Import into Unity as LevelDefinition ScriptableObjects. unlockStars / parSeconds / lengthM are balance defaults, tune after playtests.

questionTiers.2: add/subtract within 100, compare numbers, simple patterns (2,4,6,?)
questionTiers.3: times tables 2-5, shadow/shape match, doubling patterns (3,6,12,?)
questionTiers.4: times tables 2-9, exact division, tiny word math (3 boxes x 4), two-condition pick (round AND blue)
questionTiers.5: two-step (3x4+2), simple fraction compare (1/2 vs 1/3), mixed patterns, fast 2-option

challengeTypes.answer_gates: Question on HUD + sign over a row of 2-3 gates. Steer through the correct gate.
challengeTypes.fork_route: Path splits: risky shortcut (more snowflakes, more obstacles) vs safe long way. Not graded.
challengeTypes.rival_race: Race an NPC rival who also takes the challenges. Boss level at the end of each world.
challengeTypes.memory_flags: 3-5 flags shown in order (each colour = a note + a shape). Pass flag gates in the same order.
challengeTypes.follow_tracks: Forest forks. Follow the lost baby penguin's footprints. Wrong branch loops back (time loss).
challengeTypes.trick_combo: On a ramp, 2-3 arrows appear. Swipe them in order before landing. Optional bonus.
challengeTypes.color_keys: A coloured ice door blocks the way. Grab the matching key from one of 3 lanes first.
challengeTypes.cracked_ice: Frozen lake grid with a rule hint (e.g. step on stars only). Wrong tile cracks and slows you.
challengeTypes.delivery: Pick up a parcel with a number/colour, steer into the matching house's mailbox.
challengeTypes.map_flash: Night: fireworks light the course for 2 s. Remember which lane is safe.
challengeTypes.avalanche_chase: Avalanche behind you, forced high speed, shorter 2-option questions.

modifiers.dim: low light, shapes read by silhouette
